name: Margin Call
definition: Specifies the calculation and the resulting margin and independent amount needed to cover the risk exposure of one party versus another.

MarginCallValuationDate.name: Margin Call Valuation Date
MarginCallValuationDate.definition: Close of business date that initiating party is valuing the margin call.

AgreedAmount.name: Agreed Amount
AgreedAmount.definition: Specifies the amount which is undisputed.

VariationMargin.name: Variation Margin
VariationMargin.definition: Provides the summation of the call amounts for the variation margin and optionally the segregated independent amount.

SegregatedIndependentAmount.name: Segregated Independent Amount
SegregatedIndependentAmount.definition: Provides the summation of the call amounts for the segregated independent amount only.

TotalMarkToMarket.name: Total Mark To Market
TotalMarkToMarket.definition: Net unrealised profit or loss on the value of the netted, gross and failing positions.

MarkToMarketNetted.name: Mark To Market Netted
MarkToMarketNetted.definition: Unrealised net loss calculated at the participant portfolio level.

MarkToMarketGross.name: Mark To Market Gross
MarkToMarketGross.definition: Unrealised net loss calculated in that market/boundary.

MarkToMarketFails.name: Mark To Market Fails
MarkToMarketFails.definition: Sum of the unrealised loss without taking profit into consideration.

FailsHaircut.name: Fails Haircut
FailsHaircut.definition: Haircut applied to the absolute value of the participants net positions. Calculation depends on a participants credit rating.

InitialMargin.name: Initial Margin
InitialMargin.definition: Margin required for absorbing future market price fluctuations (market risks) occurring between the default of a member and close-out of unsettled securities positions by the CCP.

IncreaseCoverage.name: Increase Coverage
IncreaseCoverage.definition: Amount added to the requirement amount. Its value is at the discretion of the central clearing counterparty.

CollateralisedMarginAccountIndicator.name: Collateralised Margin Account Indicator
CollateralisedMarginAccountIndicator.definition: Used to indicate whether the reported margin account is collateralised or not. If not collateralised, the account is configured for informational reporting.

MarginProduct.name: Margin Product
MarginProduct.definition: Specifies the underlying product of the margin.

MarginType.name: Margin Type
MarginType.definition: Specifies the type of margin, for example, initial margin, variation margin, initial deposit or coupon margin.

TotalMarginAmount.name: Total Margin Amount
TotalMarginAmount.definition: Total margin requirement (expressed in the reporting currency) that must be provided. This is the total requirement calculated to cover the initial margin and the variation margin.

DefaultFundContribution.name: Default Fund Contribution
DefaultFundContribution.definition: Portion of the participation to the default fund that clearing member must provide. It is the sum of the individual contributions.

ExpectedVariationMarginType.name: Expected Variation Margin Type
ExpectedVariationMarginType.definition: Specifies the expected collateral type and direction.

ExpectedSegregatedIndependentAmountType.name: Expected Segregated Independent Amount Type
ExpectedSegregatedIndependentAmountType.definition: Specifies the expected collateral type and direction.

CollateralMovement.name: Collateral Movement
CollateralMovement.definition: Movements resulting from the margin call calculation.

RelatedManagementProcess.name: Related Management Process
RelatedManagementProcess.definition: Process which groups the activities related to collateral.

Security.name: Security
Security.definition: Description of the securities related to the margin call.
